subject: EU data residency segmentation + cold-standby top-up — amendment request
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cortechlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: infra@cortechlabs.com
Date: 2027-10-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Expansion request — EU-only environment + standby cluster at renewal

Hi Karthik,

We’re getting our FY28 budget sign-off and want to proceed with the private deployment changes we discussed during Q3. Two asks to formalize upfront: 1) split our EU traffic to a dedicated EU-only VPC (data residency and in-region processing required), and 2) add a cold-standby cluster in eu-west-1 that will be spun up for failover and disaster recovery (expected monthly cost for standby nodes only).

Can you send a proposal that includes: proposed term change to align with our fiscal year (start 2028-01-01), pricing for the standby nodes (monthly reserve + burst), and any impact on SLAs / DR runbook? We also need to include SOC2 evidence for the VPC model in the procurement packet.

Attached: Cortech_Data_Residency_Reqs.pdf, network_diagram_vpc.png

Thanks,
Asha Menon
Sr. Procurement Manager
Cortech Labs
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cortechlabs.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-31T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Expansion request — EU-only environment + standby cluster at renewal

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear ask and the diagrams. We can absolutely do both items. High-level response below and I’ll follow with a formal amendment and cost schedule by EOD Thursday.

- EU-only VPC: We will provision a dedicated EU tenant with strict routing so customer traffic and logs remain in eu-west-1. We’ll propose a 36-month term that can be aligned to your FY28 start; we can also support a 24-month option if you prefer lower commitment.
- Cold-standby cluster: Offered as a reserved monthly baseline (standby-only CPU/GPU allocation) + optional burst when activated. Standby nodes are billed at a reduced standby rate; activation incurs standard per-token/instance charges.
- SLA/DR: Standby will be covered by a DR runbook; failover tests are quarterly unless you request monthly drills. We’ll include explicit RTO/RPO targets in the amendment.

Neha — can you confirm the network/peering prerequisites and a rough timeline for provisioning the EU tenant? Monica — I’ll loop you for post-signature onboarding and runbook acceptance.

I’ve attached a placeholder amendment outline and will replace with legal-approved PDF tomorrow.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cortechlabs.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-01T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Expansion request — EU-only environment + standby cluster at renewal

Thanks Karthik. Technical notes for Cortech team — copying infra address so they see requirements:

- VPC/Networking: We require a single dedicated VPC in eu-west-1 with customer-controlled subnets for ingress/egress. We'll provide a peering/PrivateLink design. Minimal inbound/outbound ports: 443, 22 (ops), and our metrics endpoint (TCP 9300).
- Data separation: KV caches and prefix caches will be isolated per-tenant. Backups will be stored in your region and encrypted with customer-managed KMS (we can integrate your key).
- Cold-standby activation: Cold nodes will remain powered off (no token billing) but reserved; activation procedure is an API call + sanity checks (expected warm-up 8–12 minutes for typical models).
- Timeline estimate: EU tenant provisioning: 3–4 weeks after signed amendment + security questionnaire completion. Standby provisioning concurrent; activation test within 2 weeks post-provisioning.

Attachment: SOC2_Attestation.pdf (for procurement). Asha — please confirm if you need a formal network runbook or if the high-level design will suffice for procurement.

-Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cortechlabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: infra@cortechlabs.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-02T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Expansion request — EU-only environment + standby cluster at renewal

Thanks — that all looks reasonable. Procurement needs the amendment PDF and a line-item breakout of the standby monthly rate vs burst activation cost. Also: our security team insists on customer-managed KMS and a documented runbook for activation. Please include an acceptance criterion for the DR test (we require one witnessed failover).

If you can get a signed amendment in the next week we should be able to align to 2028-01-01 term start.

—Asha
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cortechlabs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-03T10:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Expansion request — EU-only environment + standby cluster at renewal

Asha — attaching the amendment and a price schedule per your request. Key points called out in the PDF: 1) Amend contract to start 2028-01-01 with a 36-month term (24-month option noted); 2) Standby pricing = 20% of equivalent active node monthly cost (reserve) + activation at standard instance rates pro-rated by minutes; 3) One witnessed DR failover test included in onboarding, additional tests available for a fee; 4) Customer-managed KMS supported (we will request key ARNs in onboarding).

Attachments: Proposed_Amendment_RDW-2027-0453_v2.pdf
DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/rdw-2027-0453-amendment

If this looks good we can route to legal and procurement; I’ve cc’d Monica for scheduling onboarding and the DR witness.

-Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Director | Redwood Inference
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@cortechlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, infra@cortechlabs.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2027-11-04T15:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Expansion request — EU-only environment + standby cluster at renewal

Marissa / team — reviewed the amendment and the numbers look good. Procurement will sign via DocuSign today. A couple of small asks before signature: can you add the acceptance criteria for the DR test to the SOW appendix (we need pass/fail checklist + expected RTO/RPO numbers)? Also confirm that standby billing begins only after we sign and provisioning is complete (i.e., no retro billing).

Once DocuSign is complete, we’ll kick off the security questionnaire and share KMS ARNs. Target: have the EU tenant provisioned and a DR witness test scheduled before 2028-01-15.

Thanks — Asha
